process_area.title: SC/PWD/Solo Parent Eligibility & In-Store Discount Program

value_stream.name: Mandatory Discount, Eligibility & Tax Credit Recovery

fields.Trigger: Customer presents discount ID at checkout

workflows.name: SC/PWD/Solo Parent ID Validation & Eligibility Verification at POS

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "checks photo, validity, and ownership" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records transaction in mandatory-discount register" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "discount with courteous explanation where invalid" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: mandatory ID capture in POS; operational: ID capture in POS
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Granting discount without valid ID forfeits tax credit; mitigated by mandatory ID capture in POS
System Touchpoints: - POS mandatory-discount module; ID validation; discount register

steps.activity: Cashier validates ID: OSCA Senior ID / PhilSys for seniors; PWD ID from NCDA-accredited LGU; Solo Parent ID from LGU; checks photo, validity, and ownership
Cashier captures ID number and customer name in POS; ERP applies statutory discount and records transaction in mandatory-discount register
Store Manager resolves disputes (expired ID, eligibility question) per protocol; denies discount with courteous explanation where invalid

workflows.name: Mandatory Discount Computation, Stack Rules & Basket Validation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Pricing configures discount rules" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "IT implements stack-prevention logic" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "audits POS application vs." (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Wrong stack/computation violates law and forfeits credit; mitigated by rule engine and audit
System Touchpoints: - Discount-rule engine; eligible-SKU mapping; POS audit log

steps.activity: Pricing configures discount rules: 20% SC/PWD (5% for groceries per RA 9994 for selected prime commodities; 32% for medicines under RA 10754 = 20% discount + 12% VAT-exempt); 10% Solo Parent on selected goods/baby items
IT implements stack-prevention logic (cannot combine SC + PWD; cannot combine statutory + promotional beyond allowed); validates eligible-SKU basket
Store Ops audits POS application vs. rule monthly; investigates computation errors; corrects configuration

workflows.name: SC/PWD Purchase Book of Sales Transaction Recording

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records each SC/PWD transaction in mandatory Book of Sales/Transactions" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates book completeness monthly per store" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "Tax Accountant archives book per location for BIR inspection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Incomplete book forfeits tax credit and incurs penalty; mitigated by auto-recording and monthly reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Mandatory-discount book register; POS reconciliation; archive

steps.activity: ERP auto-records each SC/PWD transaction in mandatory Book of Sales/Transactions (per RA 9994 IRR): date, customer name, ID number, gross amount, discount, VAT component
Tax Accountant validates book completeness monthly per store; reconciles to POS sales register; investigates gaps
Tax Accountant archives book per location for BIR inspection; maintains 10-year retention

workflows.name: Discount Abuse, ID Sharing & Fraud Prevention Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors for fraud signals" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "LP investigates flagged events" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-scan of "scan, frequency caps" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Loss risk**: ID-sharing fraud erodes margin (discount not recoverable if invalid); mitigated by monitoring and validation
System Touchpoints: - LP exception monitoring; ID-frequency analytics; CCTV correlation

steps.activity: IT/LP monitors for fraud signals: same ID used across multiple transactions/stores, frequent high-value purchases, ID photo mismatch
LP investigates flagged events; reviews CCTV; refers suspected ID-sharing/fraud to OSCA/NCDA/PNP where warranted
Store Manager reinforces cashier vigilance; LP trends abuse by store and recommends controls (ID-scan, frequency caps)

fields.Volume: Medicine and prime-commodity SKUs (limited in hardware retail)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Category Manager identifies SKUs subject to enhanced SC/PWD discount" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates no exclusion of mandatory items" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports compliance to DTI/NCDA inquiries" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-484 (ensure controlled execution — SC/PWD/Solo Parent Eligibility & In-Store Discount Program (PA-85.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Excluding eligible items violates Consumer Act and RA 9994; mitigated by SKU-master audit
System Touchpoints: - Eligible-SKU master; POS rule application; compliance audit

steps.activity: Category Manager identifies SKUs subject to enhanced SC/PWD discount (medicines 32%, selected prime commodities); maintains eligible-SKU list
Pricing ensures POS applies correct enhanced discount on eligible SKUs; validates no exclusion of mandatory items
Compliance audits eligible-SKU coverage and discount application; reports compliance to DTI/NCDA inquiries

fields.Volume: Eligible SKUs (baby/child items, school supplies, selected goods)

workflows.name: Solo Parent Discount Program Configuration & Eligible-SKU Mapping

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "10% discount + VAT exemption on baby's milk, baby food/micronutrient supplements, sanitary diapers, and prescribed child medicines" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "IT configures POS rule" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates eligible-SKU scope" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-484 (ensure controlled execution — SC/PWD/Solo Parent Eligibility & In-Store Discount Program (PA-85.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Exceeding weekly cap or wrong SKU scope; mitigated by cap-validation logic
System Touchpoints: - Eligible-SKU master; weekly-cap validation; POS rule

steps.activity: Category Manager configures Solo Parent eligible-SKU list per RA 11861 (10% discount + VAT exemption on baby's milk, baby food/micronutrient supplements, sanitary diapers, and prescribed child medicines; no weekly cap, PHP 250K annual income ceiling per RR 1-2023)
IT configures POS rule: eligible-item list validation via customer purchase history (no weekly cap under the RA 11861 IRR; income qualification verified at ID issuance); Solo Parent ID capture
Pricing audits weekly cap enforcement; validates eligible-SKU scope; refines configuration

workflows.name: Staff Training, ID Recognition & Customer Service Protocol

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "discount rules, stack prevention, customer-service protocol for denial" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "Store Ops delivers training to cashiers/sales associates" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "HR tracks certification" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-484 (ensure controlled execution — SC/PWD/Solo Parent Eligibility & In-Store Discount Program (PA-85.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Service risk**: Untrained staff mishandle discounts (deny valid, grant invalid); mitigated by certification

steps.activity: Training develops curriculum: ID types and authentication, discount rules, stack prevention, customer-service protocol for denial
Store Ops delivers training to cashiers/sales associates; certifies competency; refreshes on regulatory updates
HR tracks certification; identifies gaps; addresses non-compliance via coaching

fields.Participants: Customer Service, Store Manager, Compliance, Legal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Customer Service logs complaint" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "tracks DTI/NCSC case outcomes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-484 (ensure controlled execution — SC/PWD/Solo Parent Eligibility & In-Store Discount Program (PA-85.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational risk**: Publicized denial damages brand and invites DTI action; mitigated by rapid resolution and training
System Touchpoints: - Complaint workflow; DTI/NCSC case tracker; remediation log

steps.activity: Customer Service logs complaint; investigates root cause (staff error, system, policy misunderstanding); documents
Store Manager/Compliance resolves with customer; provides remedy (refund, apology) where warranted; responds to DTI/NCSC referral
Compliance reports recurring issues; recommends training/config changes; tracks DTI/NCSC case outcomes
